review.imagery: 32 gallery entries include 6 dated site photographs. All 22 primary assets, the complete 39-page brochure index, seventeen native resources and six September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two repeated primary views, textures, generic lifestyle photographs and a repeated clubhouse crop were excluded. Six brochure scenes add lobby, kitchen, wardrobe and facade. Cross-project SHA-256 checks identify eighteen identical architectural/interior scene groups independently published for Sunset Bay 2, 3 and 4. These renders are labelled shared developer concepts. Project-specific plan packets and historical site photographs remain separate. Confirm final release-specific design with Imtiaz.
review.floorPlans: All eight whole original physical pages 2–9 were visually reviewed on two contacts. Grouped floors and the top-level 3 BR category retain their source labels. No home area was inferred from a level drawing. The public broker page offers no open individual-plan figure. Original notices, margins and physical source links remain intact. Eight whole-building drawings retain grouped levels, unit-category legends and rooftop pool layout. No individual saleable areas are printed. The inspected broker page has no open floor-plan section. Confirm detailed home sheets, contractual areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Complete original brochure map 9 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Printed five-to-twenty-four-minute destinations were transcribed individually. The unnamed metro and source-era beach label remain explicit. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages have dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and drawings retain Tanami, Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly attribution according to the actual host. Public home images, where available, retain their openly observed figure URLs. Source bytes, whole sheets and protected researched records remain intact.
review.cardSelection: 8 November 2026: Shared developer concept · building and wider district (sunset-bay-4-by-imtiaz-district) now supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover, superseding the original cover selection. The building-and-district composition distinguishes this card from Sunset Bay 2’s shared street view and Sunset Bay 3’s rooftop pool; shared developer concept scope still applies. Own source: https://imtiaz.ae/uploads/property/exterior_gallery/32/4_E.jpg. Only the card selection changes; original gallery assets, source attribution and image-scope qualifications remain unchanged.
